Output 1: Provide women, girls and youth with the skills and knowledge that will help them get improved access to further vocational and educational opportunity or secure apprenticeship/employment Indicator: Number of Women, Youths, and people from the marginalized communities provided with employability / 21st century skills and apprenticeship/ job connect.
Baseline: 0 Target: 10,000
Output 2: Households benefitting from livelihoods and entrepreneurship opportunities increased
Indicator: 2.1: Number of households benefit from livelihoods and entrepreneurship trainings Baseline: 0 Target: 250 families
Indicator: 2.2: Number of social entrepreneurs trained to manage, grow and scale business Baseline: 0 Target: 25

Output 1: Over 16,000 youths (38% women) in the states of Karnataka, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh have improved confidence levels and enhanced leadership, negotiation and communications skills through career guidance and 21st century skilling, exposure to the world of work with over 3,000 being linked to jobs.
Output 2: Over 5,500 individuals (90% women) set up/scaled up their enterprises through training on entrepreneurship and linkage to business development support services. Nearly 5,000 vulnerable households obtained tangible benefits from enabling legislation such as direct cash transfers, maternity benefit, subsidized manufacturing tools, health insurance, scholarships for children, etc. through information, awareness, training and handholding support on application, etc.
Output 3: Over 1,100 youth innovators were trained resulting in 41 enterprises being scaled-up and 15 enterprises received seed funding
